selectionFrame.membership: identity union across all three frozen policy sets per source-changing gate

controlProtocol.method: rank eligible head candidates outside the policy-selection union by SHA-256(seed NUL gateId NUL stableCandidateId), choose smallest rank and break ties by stableCandidateId

questions.name: Speculative abstraction
questions.text: Is there an interface, provider, factory, strategy, generic mechanism, extension point, or similar abstraction with only one meaningful production use/implementation and no current requirement for variability?

questions.name: Indirection
questions.text: To understand what this code actually does, must you follow several forwarding/delegation layers before reaching the behavior?

questions.name: Change locality
questions.text: Would a small behavioral change require coordinated edits across multiple plumbing types, registrations, adapters, or mappings rather than mostly changing the code that owns the behavior?

questions.name: Hidden machinery
questions.text: Does the implementation rely on reflection, dynamic discovery, convention-based registration, a custom DSL/framework, or other implicit machinery where ordinary explicit C# could satisfy the current requirement?

questions.name: Unclear ownership
questions.text: After reading the relevant types, is it difficult to identify the single place that owns the behavior or state being reviewed?

rubric.escalation: Q4=yes or at least two yes answers among Q1,Q2,Q3,Q5
rubric.abstention: Any uncertain answer requires an uncertain decision with explanation.

analysisPlan: Validate submission manifest and source revisions before unblinding.
Do not inspect PR #16, selection artifacts, or policy mappings before judgment submission is locked.
Compare only observed judgments for the same assessed identities at equal review budget; account for shared candidates, partial coverage, uncertain outcomes, and small N.
Report scheduling selection separately from semantic findings. Controls follow the frozen protocol; no population-wide extrapolation is permitted.
These judgments are post-gate outcomes and cannot calibrate the same gate; temporal transfer requires later-gate evidence.
